author: bounded_idea_supply
question: Would an attached reporting/commitment operation on a learned predicate supply a genuinely different ready hand writer after966, without importing source claims as facts?
mechanism_considered: Preserve one learned proposition under direct assertion, an explicitly named reporter, or denial. The useful content distinction is who commits to which proposition; a reported action must not automatically create an executed physical action.
concrete_content_counterpair: REPORT(A,NOT(P)) asserts that A reports a negative proposition; it does not mean NOT(REPORT(A,P)).
REPORT(A,P) AND NOT(P) can coherently record a false report. A reader that promotes all report content to world truth makes it contradictory.

A later physical action or successful outcome does not retrospectively make every earlier allegation true. These are stipulated logical examples only, not native readings or new historical source evidence.

actual_predecessors.finding: Already states that one action proposition can occur under intention, command and report without three physical executions, and requires written mode scope and participant/reference binding. Rephrasing the same mechanism as an attached operator is not yet a new whole writer.

The curated review rejects the proposed automatic no-provenance-interaction null: lexical/content markers can correlate with reported status through topic or genre. Another structural association alone would not establish a report marker. This is a design/binding stop, not a ban on source-side reporting grammar.

The original evaluation rule's FLOW direction contradicts its own worked/counterfactual pair. The curated status is an internally inconsistent, unexecuted proposal, not a failed native experiment. A corrected evaluator would need a separately frozen variant; no silent correction or renderer is made here.
Already asks for same-procedure content under differing independently defined commitment scopes. It is not a paid physical carrier or a license to call an unchanged semantic principle new.

decision: No additional RAW card or experiment. The genuine content distinction is already explicitly present in840/033/415. An attached written exponent, fully paid speaker/name scope and complete lexical/line carrier would have to be a substantive new hand procedure; none was developed in this short block.966 is not extended into a reporting language and its frozen bytes remain unchanged.
access: Bounded idea searches/duplicates and the listed primary proposal/decision fields only. No source or native text acquisition, images, counts, encoder/decoder, root experiment, metadata refresh, ledger, route, state or other root-file edit. No additional hidden challenge.
